big.en: To begin with, as general living standards and educational levels improve, residents become more aware of their health and start to seek various ways to stay healthy.
big.cn: 首先，随着总体生活水平和教育水平的提高，居民开始对自己的健康状况更加关心，并开始寻求各种方法来保持健康。

big.en: The general public’s improved health literacy is beneficial to the whole society in many ways.
big.cn: 公众健康素养的提高在很多方面都有好处。

big.en: Moreover, government campaigns to promote public hygiene and healthy lifestyles have also played a significant role in raising residents’ health literacy.
big.cn: 此外，政府在推广公共卫生和健康生活方式方面的活动也对提高居民的健康素养起到了重要的作用。

big.en: For one thing, the rapid economic growth brings about higher disposable income, allowing people to purchase more extra goods.
big.cn: 一方面，经济的快速增长带来了更高的可支配收入，使得人们能够购买更多额外的商品。

big.en: For another, the government has released a series of preferential policies to promote \*\*\*\*\*\*, which will undoubtedly stimulate \*\*\*\*\*\*.
big.cn: 另一方面，政府制定了一系列优惠政策来促进\*\*\*\*，这无疑会刺激\*\*\*\*。

big.en: For another, government efforts in enhancing public consciousness of \*\*\*\*\*\*, such as \*\*\*\*\*\*, have helped to shape a growing body of informed residents, who have a high sense of responsibility and are earnest in implementing \*\*\*\*\*\* in their daily life.
big.cn: 另一方面，政府在提高公众对 XX 的认识方面所做的努力，如\*\*\*\*，帮助塑造了更大的知识居民群体，这一群体具有高度责任感，并会在日常生活中认真履行\*\*\*\*。

big.en: They provide us with easy online access, thereby catering to our need for a variety of information.
big.cn: 它们便于我们联网，从而能满足我们对各类信息的需求。

big.en: The increasingly intense competition in the job market has also played a part.
big.cn: 日益激烈的就业竞争也起到了一定作用。

big.en: On the other hand, with people’s living improving, this idea is changing gradually.
big.cn: 另一方面，随着人们生活水平的提高，这种观念也在悄然发生变化。

big.en: Predictably, with economic growth, graduates will enjoy more and diverse options.
big.cn: 可以预见，随着经济的发展，毕业生的选择也会日益多元化。

big.en: And only by creating the social atmosphere of respecting individual choice, can we better embrace this new trend.
big.cn: 只有全社会共同营造尊重个人选择的氛围，我们才能更好地应对新的发展趋势。

big.en: This phenomenon is related to China’s economic development.
big.cn: 这一现象与中国的经济发展有关。
big.use: 引出分论点 · 可用于第二段开头

big.en: For one thing, as the economy develops, more people can earn enough money to pay for good service or environment.
big.cn: 一方面，随着经济的发展，更多人可以赚足够的钱为好的服务或环境买单。

big.en: Anyone who would like to grasp this opportunity must know the types of food that consumers like and listen to comments from customers.
big.cn: 任何人想要抓住这一机会必须了解消费者喜欢的食物类型并听取顾客意见。

big.en: Second, China’s economy has developed rapidly, which promotes its cultural progress.
big.cn: 其次，中国的经济快速发展，推动了文化进步。

big.en: As people live a better life, they want to make it more meaningful.
big.cn: 随着生活水平的提高，人们想要使生活更有意义。

big.en: It is mainly attributed to China’s remarkable economic development that has laid a solid foundation for cultural progress.
big.cn: 这主要归功于中国经济的显著增长，为文化进步奠定了坚实基础。

big.en: For one thing, human beings seem to have natural curiosity to explore the whole wide world, and college students are no exception.
big.cn: 一方面，人类似乎天生就有探索大千世界的好奇心，大学生也不例外。

big.en: Humans crave new experiences and traveling satisfies that craving.
big.cn: 人类渴望新的体验，而旅行能满足这种渴望。

big.en: Travel helps expand your perspectives. By being exposed to new places, people and cultures, you will develop a wider world view.
big.cn: 旅行有助于拓宽视野。通过接触新的地方、人和文化，你将培养出更广阔的世界观。

big.en: By tradition, Chinese people give gifts to each other, through which they express their warm wishes.
big.cn: 按照传统，中国人互赠礼物，以此表达自己的衷心祝福。

big.en: To be sure, it is necessary to maintain good relationship with others, but this doesn’t mean we can be wasteful.
big.cn: 诚然，与他人保持良好关系是必要的，但这并不意味着我们可以浪费。

big.en: What is important is the connections between people, not money.
big.cn: 真正重要的是人与人之间的关系，而非金钱。

big.en: Although it is undeniable that this phenomenon has its benefits, such as improving the general mental well-being of the whole society, we should nonetheless beware of its negative impacts.
big.cn: 虽然不可否认，这种现象有其好处，如改善整个社会的心理健康，但我们还是应该注意其负面影响。

big.en: First, the economy of many cities in China has developed rapidly since the introduction of reform and opening-up.
big.cn: 首先，自推行改革开放以来，中国许多城市的经济迅速发展。

big.en: Then plenty of employment opportunities have been created.
big.cn: 由此，带来了大把就业机会。

big.en: We have to admit that the increase in urban population is of significance for human development.
big.cn: 我们需要承认城镇人口增加有利于人类发展。

big.en: However, it has also brought many social and environment problems.
big.cn: 然而它也带来了很多社会和环境问题。

big.en: With the advances in society and updating and enrichment of education, the quality of the residents has improved.
big.cn: 随着社会的进步和教育的丰富和发展，居民的素质也得到了很大的提高。

big.en: Education improves the workforce’s skills, leading to higher productivity and economic growth.
big.cn: 教育提升了劳动力的技能，促进了更高的生产力和经济增长。

cats.title: 第二段 · 原因 / 机制句
cats.desc: 接在引入句或高级衔接词后面；For one thing / Moreover 这类开头词句子里自带，别再重复加。

cats.title: 背景 · 观念 / 意义句
cats.desc: 第二段开头引出分论点，或第三段谈意义时用。

cats.title: 结尾 · 总结 / 预测 / 利弊句
cats.desc: 收束段直接用；先写立场句（On balance...）再接这些。
